BL-1103 — The wall-clock-bounded subprocess runner exists twice, hand-copied trap for hand-copied trap: fold expedite_cli.bb's sh-bounded and babysitter_check.bb's run-bounded! into one shared lib both source
What it solves: Filed by the specifier 2026-08-23 from the coder's BL-1071 findings note (follow-up a, backlog/evidence/BL-1071-coder-findings.md on the coder branch): "run-bounded! now exists twice, in expedite_cli.bb and babysitter_check.bb, carrying the same two hard-won traps. This is the hand-copy shape BL-57…
Approval context: Nothing about the extraction itself needs a ruling - the two copies are the same function and BL-571 already records this hand-copy shape as a defect class. The one decision is the new lib's NAME, because it is pinned in this ticket's required_wiring and so must be settled before the coder starts: …
BL-1103 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1103" (or "reject BL-1103 <reason>") to act.
